name: wechat-search/v2/search
description: Search WeChat with one endpoint: official account articles, accounts, Channels videos, live streams, news and more. Filter by vertical, sort and publish time, with cursor pagination.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Optional, default True. True=raw search response; False=simplified parsing.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Optional, default `default`. Sort (result page "sort" dropdown, common to all verticals) — `default`/0 (relevance) / `latest`/1 (newest) / `hot`/2 (most liked); string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Optional. Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; for the next page pass back the `cursor` returned in the previous response (repeat the same `sort` / `publish_time`), and use `continue_flag` to check whether there are more pages.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Optional, default 0 (>=0). Pass `0` for the first page; **use `cursor` to paginate — offset alone does not work** (it returns the first page every time).

publish_time.title: Publish Time
publish_time.description: Optional, default `all`. Publish time (result page "time" dropdown, common) — `all`/0 / `day`/1 / `week`/2 / `half_year`/3; string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400).

business_type.title: Business Type
business_type.description: Optional, default `all`. Vertical string key, only the following are supported — `all` / `account` / `article` / `video` / `live_stream` / `moments` / `news` / `book` / `listen` / `image` / `encyclopedia` / `weixin_index`; any other value is rejected (422).

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

input.keyword: 南开大学 法学院 2026 博士 拟录取名单

readme: # WeChat Search API Searches WeChat for a keyword and returns matching results from the vertical you choose with `business_type`, such as official account articles, accounts, Channels videos, live streams or news. It needs one input, `keyword`. Filters for sort order and publish time narrow the results. ## Use cases - Track new official account articles about a brand or topic with `sort` set to `latest`. - Collect article titles, snippets and links for a keyword to build a media monitoring feed. - Find which official accounts publish most on a subject by reading the source name of each result. - Limit a search to the last day or week with `publish_time` to check recent coverage. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/wechat-search/v2/search" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI", "business_type": "article", "raw": false}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search keyword (1-100 chars) | | `business_type` | string | No | Optional, default `all`. Vertical string key, only the following are supported — `all` / `account` / `article` / `video` / `live_stream` / `moments` / `news` / `book` / `listen` / `image` / `encyclopedia` / `weixin_index | | `cursor` | string | No | Optional. Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; for the next page pass back the `cursor` returned in the previous response (repeat the same `sort` / `publish_time`), and use `continue_flag` to check whether | | `offset` | integer | No | Optional, default 0 (>=0). Pass `0` for the first page; **use `cursor` to paginate — offset alone does not work** (it returns the first page every time). | | `publish_time` | string | No | Optional, default `all`. Publish time (result page "time" dropdown, common) — `all`/0 / `day`/1 / `week`/2 / `half_year`/3; string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400). | | `raw` | boolean | No | Optional, default True. True=raw search response; False=simplified parsing. | | `sort` | string | No | Optional, default `default`. Sort (result page "sort" dropdown, common to all verticals) — `default`/0 (relevance) / `latest`/1 (newest) / `hot`/2 (most liked); string key or integer, invalid values rejected (400). | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "business_type": 2, "categories": null, "continue_flag": 1, "count": 38, "cursor": "hO0SuC6V7gEWmcGXQvsJ5wYWU4HyplzRxHlbePoYMtHLQY0vwElfi8d9LA-X87FzUQ7qOvpJTpv4SPHP…", "debug_id": "e5835ac5", "debug_info": "gAAAAABq6ZE7ot2LojpCJR304JESp7F_lWS4y7oOLUfqwVqQ9TIO8WNyZlsFYGWjOnT9jqzEk27z2sgB…", "items": [ { "date": 1793688900, "desc": "OpenAI不是一家普通的公司。GPT-6 Astra、5亿年化营收、全球最大的AI用户入口，这些东西是真…", "docID": "5774067735576686510", "docType": 0, "doc_url": "http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzU4ODQwNTIxMw==&mid=2247595037&idx=1&sn=8c2c2d5…", "itemShowType": 0, "mpScene": 7, "source": { "dateTime": "51分钟前", "title": "人工智能产业链union" }, "src_type": 49, "thumbUrl": "https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/sz_mmbiz_jpg/9NdMVNE3GyZlQFyh70as5OnDBo1sPia1hpUW8PMhpoHnf…", "timestamp": 1793688900, "title": "【投融资】没人抢了：OpenAI的估值，一周之内自己砍掉了1500亿美元" } ], "keyword": "OpenAI", "no_more": null, "offset": 38, "total": 280 } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `items[].title` | Article title. Search matches are wrapped in `` tags. | | `items[].desc` | Short text snippet of the article, with matched keywords wrapped in `` tags. | | `items[].doc_url` | Link to the article on mp.weixin.qq.com. | | `items[].source.title` | Name of the official account that published the article. | | `items[].source.dateTime` | Relative publish time as shown on the WeChat result page, for example `51分钟前` or `1天前`. | | `items[].timestamp / items[].date` | Publish time of the article as a Unix timestamp in seconds. | | `items[].thumbUrl` | Cover image URL for the article. | | `items[].docID` | Identifier of the result document. | | `count / total` | `count` is the number of items in this page's result. `total` is the overall result count reported by the search. | | `continue_flag / cursor` | `continue_flag` is `1` when more pages exist. `cursor` is the value to pass back to get the next page. | ## Notes - To get the next page, pass the returned `cursor` back with the same `keyword`, `sort` and `publish_time`. Check `continue_flag` first. - `offset` alone does not paginate. It returns the first page every time, so use `cursor`. - `sort` accepts `default`, `latest` or `hot`. `publish_time` accepts `all`, `day`, `week` or `half_year`. - To search only accounts, articles or Channels videos, see [WeChat Account Search](/apis/wechat-search/search-account), [WeChat Article Search](/apis/wechat-search/search-article) or [WeChat Search for Channels Videos](/apis/wechat-search/v2/search-videos). ## Pricing $0.01 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [WeChat Search for Channels Videos](/apis/wechat-search/v2/search-videos): Search WeChat Channels videos specifically (`video` vertical), with the result page's "duration" filter, "relevance/newest/most-liked" sort, and "time" dropdow…
